source_basis: Python3.12 os.posix_spawn docs: optional setsid flag may raise NotImplementedError.
Pinned pyconfig independently declares HAVE_SETSID; Python os.setsid docs and Linux setsid(2) define a separate call in a non-group-leader child.
No actual kernel setsid call/permission has yet succeeded in this experiment.
limits: All21rows unexercised; prototype is not accepted for runtime or production. Old unsupported route stays failed and immutable. Readmission is an explicit reviewed implementation change preserving fresh-session-before-data, not an automatic fallback or a bypass of an OS denial.
